pages.title: Food Effects
pages.description: By cooking fruits  from one archwood  with barks from  another, one can  neutralize the  negative effects  into something new  and activate more  beneficial effects.   Food made with  wilden drops will  provide wilden  effect that aids
spell casting. Food  with better  ingredient gives  higher level.

pages.title: Mendosteen Tea
pages.description: Flourishing effect  will restore player  mana when player  heals. When player  recovers x% of their  health, this effect  will recover same  percentage of player  mana.   Every level up  doubles mana  restoration

pages.title: Bastion Tea
pages.description: Synchronized Shield  effect will give  absorption to player  when player heals.  Player gains same  amount of absorption  as their healing  amount, up to a  maximum amount  determined by effect  level.   Every level up  doubles maximum
absorption and  amount of absorption  gained

pages.title: Bombegranate Tea
pages.description: Blast Resistance  effect is similar to  resistance effect  but only applies to  explosion damage. It  stacks  multiplicatively  with other forms of  damage reduction.   Every level provides  20% of damage  reduction, and at  level 5 it makes

pages.title: Frostaya Tea
pages.description: Freezing Spell  effect will inflict  freezing effect when  player's spell hurt  another entity.   The inflicted  freezing effect will  have the same level  and duration as the  Freezing Spell  effect currently on  player.

pages.title: Wilden Meat
pages.description: Wilden effect will  increase player max  mana, mana  regeneration, and  spell damage.   By default, each  level increases 20%  max mana, mana  regen, and spell  damage. The number  can be tweaked  individually in  config.
